summary: Spells come alive, the Goblin Chief needs two heroes and the game ends in a victory screen at level 10. Every spell has an icon. The first 21 spells have animations and sounds. This list covers v0.3.1, v0.3.2 and v0.4.

highlights.title: Spell effects
highlights.text: Cast, flight, impact and status animations, with a sound for every part.

highlights.title: Two heroes for the boss
highlights.text: The Goblin Chief's Lair needs a party of 2. One hero must reach level 10.

highlights.title: Legs slot
highlights.text: Legplates, Breeches and Leggings. The game now has 11 equipment slots.

highlights.title: Bigger mill
highlights.text: Buy more storage and a faster mill at the Bank.

highlights.title: New affixes
highlights.text: Critical chance, Critical damage and Life steal, plus 8 more affixes.

groups.heading: Spell effects
items: The first 21 spells (up to level 10 of each class) have a look: a cast on the caster, a projectile that flies to the target, an impact on the target, and a buff or debuff that stays on its unit while the status lasts.
Every look has a colour theme: Steel, Nature, Fire, Ice, Arcane, Holy, Shadow, Rage, Ki and Guard.

items.label: Sounds
items.text: 29 new synthesised sounds, one for each part of a look. Hits of one spell come 0.16 seconds apart.

items: The Spells page of this wiki now shows the animations and plays the sounds.

groups.heading: Spell icons
items: All 140 spells have an icon. A spell up to level 10 has its own picture. Higher spells use a picture from their class and effect. An Ultimate has a gold ring.

groups.heading: Critical hits and life steal

items.label: Critical damage
items.text: A critical hit now uses the critical damage of the attacker. The base is 1.5x.

items.label: Life steal
items.text: A unit with life steal heals for a share of the damage it deals.

items: New gear affixes add Critical chance, Critical damage and Life steal.

groups.heading: Experience
items: Experience is now a table of fixed numbers in the game data. There is no level gap factor and no formula in the first 10 levels.
A kill pays a number from the table for the hero level and the monster level. A monster above the hero level pays like a monster of the hero level.

items.label: Rank multipliers
items.text: A rare monster pays 3x (it was 5x). A boss pays 5x (it was 20x).

items: A level 10 hero needs about 19 kills of level 1 monsters. Each lower dungeon adds about 3 kills.

groups.heading: Mill
items: The Mill starts with room for 1 material and a material every 10 minutes.

items.label: Storage
items.text: 5 upgrades at the Bank add room for 1 material each. They cost 300, 900, 2700, 8100 and 24300 copper.

items.label: Speed
items.text: 5 upgrades at the Bank cut the time to 8, 6, 4.5, 3.3 and 2.5 minutes. They cost 250, 750, 2250, 6750 and 20250 copper.

items: The Mill settings are kept in the save with a migration, so old saves keep working.

groups.heading: Level cap
items: Heroes stop at level 10. The hero screen shows a MAX LEVEL bar.
The Academy hides spells above level 10, because no hero can learn them.
Hero recovery at the cap takes 82 seconds (it was 300 seconds at level 100).

groups.heading: Victory screen
items: The first clear of the Goblin Chief's Lair opens a full-page victory screen with rays, confetti, a trophy, your heroes and a fanfare. You can watch it again in Settings.

items.label: Hall of Fame
items.text: A card for each winning hero with stat bars, power and battle record, and totals for your adventure: dungeons cleared, items crafted, fights fought, monsters defeated, spells learned and heroes in your company.

groups.heading: Priest
items: The Priest now opens after the Goblin Chief's Lair (it was Goblin Camp).
Minor Heal heals 200% (it was 183%) and costs 5 Mana. Smite costs 6 Mana and Divine Shield costs 8 Mana.

groups.heading: Archer, Thief, Fighter
items: Archer Skill growth is 2.48 for each level (it was 2.18). Thief Skill growth is 2.21 (it was 2.06). Fighter Strength growth is 2.3 (it was 2.15).

groups.heading: Resources
items: Mana and Stamina start lower and grow more with levels, and each Magic or Strength point adds less. Both come back faster: Mana 2.6% and Stamina 3.4% of the maximum each second.

groups.heading: Legs slot
items: A new slot with Legplates (Heavy), Breeches (Medium) and Leggings (Light). Each has set recipes from every monster set material.
Crafter levels changed so no two armour slots of one profession share a level. Shield opens at level 8, Belt at 6 and Tome at 8.
Set pieces open one after another. No set recipe goes above crafter level 10, so a level 10 crafter can make every item. Late pieces of late sets share level 10.

groups.heading: Item level
items: A recipe now has one fixed item level: the recipe level, never above the end of its tier. The random roll is gone.
A hero needs the item level to equip the item. The item card shows Requires level N in gold, and the classes that can use it.

groups.heading: Affixes
items: 11 new affixes: of Insight, of the Sage (Magic), of the Tortoise (Defence), of the Veil (Resistance), of the Whale (Health), of the Titan (Strength), of the Hawk (Skill), of the Fox (Speed), of the Leech (Life steal), of the Viper (Critical chance) and of Carnage (Critical damage).

groups.heading: Workshop
items: The recipe list has a filter by class and by slot, and a sort by level. The Workshop shows the item level before you craft.

groups.heading: Cost and value

items.label: Crafter fee
items.text: 1 copper plus 0.25 copper for each required level (it was 3 plus 0.5).

items.label: Sell value
items.text: The quality factors doubled: Common 2x, Magic 4x, Rare 8x and Unique 20x. Crafting now pays for the spells of a hero.

items: The recipe tables of the wiki show the item level of each recipe.

groups.heading: Goblin Chief

items.label: Two heroes
items.text: The Goblin Chief's Lair needs exactly 2 heroes. One hero must reach level 10. The partner can be weaker. A new window lets you choose the party.

items: A level 9 or 10 hero with a level 4 or 5 partner wins about 90% of the time, for every class.
Defeating the Goblin Chief shows a Victory screen. It has a link to this wiki and a Keep playing button.

groups.heading: Monsters
items: Monsters from level 7 on and the monsters of Goblin Camp and Old Wood Hollow are harder: about 7% more HP and Defence, and more attack.
Goblin Captain and Hollow Broodmother have 1.6x attack.

groups.heading: Dungeons
items: The dungeon details window has a Fight! button.
A run report has a Repeat button that starts the same dungeon again.

groups.heading: Menus
items: Dropdown lists now use the game style.
Links in the game open the matching wiki pages.

sections.title: Known issues
sections.intro: These problems are known and are not fixed in this version.

groups.heading: Game
items: Spells above level 10 and monster spells have no animations or sounds yet.
Two level 10 heroes with only their best weapons win about 51% against the Goblin Chief.
